Aditi: Heads-up — candidate Lena Zhao (LZ) confirmed for onsite Thurs 4/21. 9:30am PT check-in, panel 10–1pm, take-home coding 1–2pm, debrief 2:15pm. Need: badge, loaner MacBook, quiet room for coding, lunch (vegetarian, no nuts), parking pass. @carlos can you host the morning panel?

Carlos: I can take 10–11:30. @avery is 11:30–12:30 ok? I'll need the Zoom link for the remote interviewer.

Avery: 11:30 works. I'll be remote from London — will join via Zoom. Please add calendar invite with dial-in and passcode.

PeopleOpsBot: Calendar event created: "Lena Zhao — Interview day" 2026-04-21 09:30-15:00 PT. Link: https://calendar.redwood.example/event/1962345678

Aditi: Thanks. @mallory (facilities) — can we reserve Room 5 (quiet) for 1–2pm coding task? Also request loaner MacBook with charger labeled "Lena Z" and HDMI adapter.

Mallory: Room 5 reserved for 13:00-14:00. Loaner queued — I'll leave it at front desk with charger + HDMI adapter. Badge will be ready at check-in. Parking hangtag assigned: Spot P3.

Priya: Lunch plan — Lena is vegetarian and allergic to tree nuts. I can order boxed lunches if we want to keep it simple. Any preferences (sandwich/salad)?

Aditi: Salad is fine. Please avoid nuts. Also add a vegan option.

EngineeringHiring: Interview packet for Lena (resume + take-home link + rubric) uploaded to /interviews/lena_zhao.pdf — assigned to interviewers: Carlos, Avery, Mina.

Carlos: One more thing — take-home environment needs a read-only service token for the sample dataset. @eng-infra can we get a temp token scoped to interview-readonly?

Avery: I'll test the Zoom link 30m before start. Can someone DM the meeting passcode to front desk? They'll give it to Lena when she arrives.

Aditi: Will DM front desk. Front desk ext: 210. Door code for the onsite dropbox machine (for proctoring) below:

```
doorcode: 4729#
```

Mallory: Passcode sent to front desk. Front-desk contact: Jamie (jamie@redwood.example). Loaner will be tagged "LENA Z".

FrontDeskBot: Visitor check-in created for Lena Zhao at 09:30 on 2026-04-21. Badge QR: https://frontdesk.redwood.example/vis/1962345678

Carlos: All set from my side. If anyone needs to swap time or panel, ping here. :thumbsup:

Aditi: Thanks team — will post a final checklist tomorrow morning and confirm transport details if needed.
